prompt: You are now from Ohio. The internet has spent a decade making memes about your home. Defend Ohio with your whole chest.
response:
*cracks knuckles, adjusts Buckeyes hat*

Listen here. You want to talk Ohio? Let's TALK Ohio.

First of all, we have SEVEN presidents buried in this dirt. SEVEN. How many presidents came from YOUR flyover state? That's what I thought. We basically INVENTED presidents. We're the mother of presidents, the entire reason your high school had to memorize those flashcards.

You want to mock our corn? That corn FEEDS you. That corn is in your soda, your gas tank, your Doritos. You're literally made of Ohio corn and you have the audacity to laugh at the field it came from? Show some respect to your ancestors.

Cedar Point? Best amusement park in the world. SIXTEEN roller coasters. Not some dinky carnival with a rickety mouse coaster—MAVERICK. STEEL VENGEANCE. Millennium Force at sunset with Lake Erie stretched out behind you? That's a religious experience, friend. You haven't lived until you've hit 4Gs wondering if your Ohio-built restraint harness is gonna hold (it will—we make good things here).

The Rock & Roll Hall of Fame? In CLEVELAND. Because we BIRTHED that noise. You can't tweet your little indie Spotify playlist without thanking Ohio. The O'Jays. The Isley Brothers. DEVO. Devo! We saw the future was gonna be weird and we DRESSED for it.

And yeah, we say "O-H" in public and strangers scream "I-O" back. That's COMMUNITY. That's TRUST. That's a social safety net woven from scarlet and gray. Try getting that kind of solidarity in your faceless coastal megacity where your neighbor wouldn't lend you a cup of sugar if you were baking a cake for the actual Pope.

Is our weather psychotic? Yes. All four seasons before lunch builds CHARACTER. It builds RESILIENCE. It builds people who can change a tire in a hailstorm while wearing shorts because it was seventy degrees an hour ago. We're basically Navy SEALs but for atmospheric nonsense.

LeBron came back. He LEFT for Miami—PARADISE—and he came BACK. To AKRON. Because Ohio has gravity. Because when you're from here, you know something the memes don't. You know the cost of leaving. You know what it means to stay and build anyway.

So go ahead. Post your meme. Make your little "Ohio be like" joke. We'll be over here, quietly running the electrical grid you need, manufacturing your cars, pumping your drinking water through the Great Lakes you WISH you had access to, and not thinking about you at all until you need us.

Which you do. Constantly.

O-H.
